hooks.command: sh -c 'in=$(cat); case "$in" in *"gh pr"*) dir="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); gate="$root/.claude/hooks/pr-gate.py"; if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$gate" ]; then echo "PR gate: cannot find .claude/hooks/pr-gate.py from $dir; refusing pull request commands" >&2; exit 2; fi; printf %s "$in" | python3 "$gate";; esac'
